test_proportional_sampling: test the MultiDatasetLoader proportional sampling to verify larger datasets are sampled more frequently
test_equal_sampling: test the MultiDatasetLoader equal sampling to verify all datasets are sampled with equal probability
test_infer_dataset_probabilities: test the _infer_dataset_probabilities method to verify correct probability inference based on dataset sizes
test_prepare_batch: test the prepare_batch method to verify batch preparation and dataset key extraction
test_multi_dataset_loader_iteration: test iterating over MultiDatasetLoader to verify correct batch yields across multiple datasets
